top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There is no policy for suspension and expulsion.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The director's files is incomplete and does not have proof of orientation, DL/ID, pre-affidavit, nor an signed affidavit.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Duration (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies do not address duration of physical activities.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.
